(i) the online optimization of a tropical hydropower reservoir with the use of deterministic forecasts leads to a 10% increase in energy production, and (ii) the online optimization with the use of stochastic forecasts leads to a further increase of 5%, and a 20% reduction in flood damage.

(1) the stochastic optimization of hydropower reservoirs can be used to improve flood protection without compromising energy production, and that (2) probabilistic forecasts are more suitable than deterministic forecasts to support this optimization.

the use of probabilistically forecasted inflow scenarios for the online optimization of hydropower reservoirs in the short-term.
the development of a novel, efficient and reliable approach for the optimization of hydropower reservoir operations.
the short-term optimization of a hydropower reservoir.
